notes: Federal floor (29 U.S.C. §206) plus the California overlay. Verbatim anchors verified 2026-08-23: federal via Cornell LII; CA rate via the CA DIR 2026 adjustment announcement. The machine-readable values the tool computes with live in ../state_rules.json; these chunks are the citable prose. Numbers must match state_rules.json.

chunks.title: Federal minimum wage
chunks.text: The federal minimum wage under the Fair Labor Standards Act is $7.25 an hour. A state or locality may set a higher minimum wage, in which case the higher rate applies.

chunks.source: Cal. Lab. Code §1182.12; CA DIR 2026 adjustment
chunks.title: California minimum wage (2026)
chunks.text: California's minimum wage is $16.90 per hour effective January 1, 2026, for all employers. California's minimum is adjusted annually for inflation and exceeds the federal $7.25 floor, so the California rate applies to California worksites.
